hookups.source: https://www.ccprc.com/campground/campground/ ('Each full hook-up site has a sewer connection, water spigot, and 20/30/50 amp electric connections'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 118 full-hookup sites (pull-through and back-in) and 6 water/electric sites, all 20/30/50 amp; the county says the pull-through sites run up to 80 ft. Also 15 walk-in primitive tent sites, 7 group tent areas, 10 cottages, and 5 dry overflow sites used only when the campground is full. Paved roads; up to 6 people per site.

sites.source: https://charlestoncountyparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/the-campground-at-james-island-county-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=CHST&parkId=1240020 (site types: Full Hookup (118), Standard Electric (6), Primitive Tent Campsite (15), Overflow Campsite (5), Primitive Group Area (7), Cottage (10)) + https://www.ccprc.com/campground/campground/ ('spacious pull-thru RV sites (up to 80 feet)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Modern bathhouses, an activity center and a 24-hour staffed office; propane, ice and firewood for sale.

facilities.source: https://www.ccprc.com/campground/campground/ ('a full-service campground store, laundry facilities, free Wi-Fi, dump station, and propane, ice, and firewood sales'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve online (Charleston County Parks' ReserveAmerica site) or at 843-795-4386, up to one year ahead, paid in full when booked; not by email. No long-term stays. Check-in after 1 pm; after the 8 pm office close, a ranger checks guests in via the call box. A reservation includes free gate admission to the park.

booking.source: https://www.ccprc.com/campground/campground/ ('may be made up to one year prior to your arrival date'; 'We do not offer long-term stays and have a maximum stay of 28 nights'; check-in after 1 p.m.) + ReserveAmerica campground page (gate admission, call box), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Water & electric site $63 off-peak, $68 Memorial Day-Labor Day, $73 during the Holiday Festival of Lights. Full-hookup back-in $68-73 off-peak, $73-78 in summer, $83-88 during the festival (lower figure Sunday-Thursday); pull-through $80-99. Plus 14% accommodations tax and a $5 non-refundable transaction fee per site. Overflow dry camping $45 (only when full); primitive tent $38-43. Active-duty/retired military and seniors 60+ may get 10% off.
